description_en: Queries the list of tags that are bound to resources. Currently, Instance resources are supported
description_zh: 查询资源已经绑定的标签列表。当前支持实例 Instance 资源
kebab_example: aliyun cr list-tag-resources --resource-type Instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Currently, Instance resources are supported
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义，当前支持实例Instance资源
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resource ID. You can specify up to 20 resources
parameters.help_zh: 资源 ID。最多支持添加20个资源
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. If you specify this parameter, you cannot set it to an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. If you specify this parameter, you can set it to an empty string.

A tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if no more results exist. If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query or if no more results exist. If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
NextToken.description_zh: 是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
